title: 第4章 三叔第5章 诡魅303
content_zh:
：听三叔这么说，我瞬间就没底了，要是骗不过我也是个死。
“这么说，我还是可能被那女鬼给杀了。”
“那吊坠你戴好，关键时刻能救你一命。”
我连忙护好胸前的吊坠，这可是我最后的救命稻草啊，到六点的时候，我爸拿着一只五彩尾巴的大公鸡回来了。
三叔找了个碗，猛地一下拽掉公鸡的头，把鸡血接了一碗，然后用毛笔蘸着在我一衣服上写下了我的生辰八字，阴年阴月阴日阴时，接着还在上面画了一道符，并且口中还念念有词：“鼠北牛中虎兔东，龙中牛蛇南方行，羊中鸡猴向东面，狗中老猪北方行。
借命一用，死后安宁。”
三叔念罢，那具无头男尸竟然从棺材里爬了出来，之后他径直走到三叔身边定了下来。
“三叔，这怎么回事？”
我惊讶的问道。
三叔表现的很镇定，指了指刚才男尸躺的棺材冷冷的说道：“躺进去。”
“什么？你让我躺棺材，这不是咒我早死吗？”
我来找你就是为了救命呢，你让我躺棺材里，这他妈多晦气。
“如果骗不过那女鬼，你躲在棺材里还是暂时安全的。”
“南子听三叔的，人道行高深还能骗你不成。”
我拗不过他俩只得躺了进去，这棺材里都是无头男尸的血，黏糊糊的躺在里面十分的恶心，但为了能活命，我也只好强忍着自己少呼吸。
“你躺在这里不要动，等过了十二点，骗过了女鬼，你再出来。”
三叔嘱咐我道。
“要是骗不过呢？”
我有些不放心的说道。
“那你就躲在里面别出来，不管外面发生什么，你都别出声。”

三叔说的煞有其事，我也不知道是真是假，只好照做。
“以免那女鬼发现南子，把棺材盖合上。”
三叔跟我爸说道。
“盖上棺材盖我不得闷死了。”
“像活命就听我的。”
三叔厉声呵斥道。
我只好闭嘴，他们把棺材盖给我留了一条缝，两人就出去了，期间老爸还有些担忧的回头看看我，但是被三叔给推拉着带出去了。
二人走后，整个棺材铺就剩我和一具无头男尸了，透着棺材缝我看到那具无头男尸依旧直直的站着，我的衣服穿在他身上正好，只是没了头不知道长什么样。
我在棺材里面躺着度日如年，再加上外面静的出奇，我竟然想睡觉，就当我困意袭来的时候，屋里突然传来一阵女人凄厉的笑声。
那女鬼来索我命来了。
意识到危险来临，我忙屏住呼吸，不敢有任何动静。
透过棺材的缝隙我看见那女鬼穿着一身红色吊带裙，手里拿着一件寿衣缓缓的向那个替身飘了过去。
“老公，来试试我给你买的新衣服。”
那女鬼拿着衣服在那具无头男尸身上比了比，突然笑道：“宝贝，你的头呢？”
不好，被那女鬼发现这是个假的了。
“对了，我才想起来你的头在我肚子里，昨天刚把你吃了。”
我紧张的哦咽了口吐沫，不敢发出一点声响，这你妈骗不过去，我小命不就玩完了吗？
本以为女鬼说吃进肚子里了，就骗过去了，可没想到她下一个举动，瞬间改变了我的想法。
content_en:
: Hearing what Uncle San said, I instantly lost my bottom. If I couldn’t be deceived, I would be dead.
"So, I might still be killed by that female ghost."
"Wear that pendant. It can save your life at a critical moment."
I quickly protected the pendant on my chest. This was my last life-saving straw. At six o'clock, my dad came back with a big rooster with a colorful tail.
The third uncle found a bowl, suddenly pulled off the rooster's head, took the chicken blood into the bowl, and then dipped a writing brush on my clothes and wrote my birth date, yin year, yin month, yin day, yin time. Then he also drew a talisman on it, and muttered something like: "Rat in the north, ox in the east, tiger and rabbit in the east, dragon in the ox and snake in the south, sheep in the rooster and monkey in the east, dog in the old pig in the north."
Take advantage of your life and enjoy peace after death. "
After the third uncle finished reading, the headless male corpse climbed out of the coffin. After that, he walked straight to the third uncle and settled down.
"Third uncle, what's going on?"
I asked in surprise.
The third uncle acted very calmly, pointed to the coffin where the man's body was lying just now, and said coldly: "Lie in."
"What? If you let me lie in the coffin, isn't this a curse on me to die early?"
I came to you just to save my life. You let me lie in a coffin. How fucking unlucky.
"If you can't fool that female ghost, you'll be safe for the time being hiding in the coffin."
"Nanzi, listen to your third uncle. He is a man of great virtue and can still deceive you."
I couldn't resist them and had to lie down in the coffin. The coffin was filled with the blood of the headless man's corpse. It was very disgusting to lie in the sticky coffin. But in order to survive, I had to endure my lack of breathing.
"You lie here and don't move. Wait until twelve o'clock and you have deceived the female ghost, and then you can come out."
Third uncle told me.
"What if I can't be fooled?"
I said a little worried.
"Then just hide inside and don't come out. No matter what happens outside, don't make a sound."
What the third uncle said was true, and I didn’t know if it was true or not, so I had no choice but to do it.
"In order to prevent the female ghost from discovering Nanzi, close the coffin lid."
Third uncle told my dad.
"Close the coffin lid and I will suffocate to death."
"Just listen to me if you want to survive."
Third uncle scolded sternly.
I had no choice but to shut up, and they left a crack in the coffin lid for me, and the two of them went out. During this period, my father looked back at me worriedly, but he was pushed and pulled out by my third uncle.
After the two left, I and a headless male corpse were the only ones left in the entire coffin shop. Through the cracks in the coffin, I saw that the headless male corpse was still standing upright. My clothes fit him perfectly, but I don’t know what he looked like without his head.
I lay in the coffin for a long time, and it was so quiet outside that I actually wanted to sleep. Just when I was feeling sleepy, a woman's shrill laughter suddenly came from the room.
That female ghost has come to claim my life.
Realizing that the danger was coming, I held my breath and didn't dare to make any move.
Through the gap in the coffin, I saw the female ghost wearing a red suspender skirt and slowly floating towards the substitute with a shroud in her hand.
"Honey, come try on the new clothes I bought you."
The female ghost showed her clothes to the headless male corpse, and suddenly smiled and said, "Baby, where's your head?"
No, the female ghost found out that it was a fake.
"By the way, I just remembered that your head was in my stomach and I just ate you yesterday."
I swallowed nervously and didn't dare to make a sound. Your mother couldn't fool you. Wouldn't my life be over?
I thought that the female ghost would lie to me by saying that I had eaten it, but I didn’t expect that her next move would instantly change my mind.
